* '''Original''' ([[Ice-Heart]]): titled “•Ice-Heart” (no “(V)”) on the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010), p. 2, and on the PC website card list from 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013: “Power +3 while defending a battle with a spy. While with a non-frozen captive, attrition against opponent everywhere is +2. During your move phase, may use 1 Force to ‘break cover’ of an Undercover spy here. Immune to attrition < 3.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010), page 2, slip 5 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="cl-1271_5-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive): “Ice-Heart”</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): On 29 January 2013 the [[Players Committee]] announced the persona-name change “Ice Heart ---> Ysanne Isard”, effective immediately (old slips stayed tournament-legal; non-gameplay lore was removed; “Each of the cards will retain their gametext and characteristics”)<ref name="persona2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref>. The title changed to “•Ysanne Isard”; the game text did not change. The PC website card list shows the new title by 14 March 2013 (the last capture with the old title is of 11 January 2013), and the Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 15) prints the card as •Ysanne Isard with new art (“Original Image courtesy of www.hydraworx.net”).<ref name="cl-1271_5-2013-03-14">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130314031820/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-03-14] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130516000419/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-05-16] (Internet Archive): “Ysanne Isard” (these captures carry no game text)</ref><ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014).
